name: Skeptic
reason: History says every past August had a bloom, which I grudgingly respect, but a 25.4 C weekly max, one hot day, and 21 mm of rain on top of 47.9 mm over 14 days point to mixing and dilution, and a cyano index of 0.135 is hardly a smoking gun.
evidence: bloom_rate_this_month_past_years = 1.0, the one strong pro-bloom signal
max_temp_avg 25.4 C with only 1 hot day, which is lukewarm for bloom growth
rain_total_mm 21.0 this week and 47.9 mm over 14 days, which favors mixing and dilution
cyano_index 0.135, up only 0.022 from last week, a modest rise that could be noise
